items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Have you seen Alvin Alcar lately?' and the interviewee does not respond with any personal anecdote or confirmation of a relationship, only acknowledging the interviewer's statement.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . Have you seen Alvin Alcar lately? No, I haven't seen him in about six weeks. He played last week, I guess, at Paddock. When George was gone, he took him Tuesday night. Oh, yeah.
That's a very good record. Glad you enjoyed it. Yeah, I enjoyed it. I don't see why you shouldn't.
